// CASE await_task_value_inline expect=fire
func s1(_ items: [Int]) async -> [Int] {
  var out: [Int] = []
  for item in items {
    out.append(await Task(priority: .utility) { await work(item) }.value)
  }
  return out
}

// CASE await_task_value_multiline expect=fire
func s2(_ items: [Int]) async -> [Int] {
  var out: [Int] = []
  for item in items {
    let value = await Task(priority: .utility) {
      await work(item)
    }.value
    out.append(value)
  }
  return out
}

// CASE try_await_detached_value expect=fire
func s3(_ items: [Int]) async throws -> [Int] {
  var out: [Int] = []
  for item in items {
    let value = try await Task.detached(priority: .background) {
      try await load(item)
    }.value
    out.append(value)
  }
  return out
}

// CASE await_task_result expect=fire
func s4(_ items: [Int]) async {
  for item in items {
    _ = await Task(priority: .low) {
      try await load(item)
    }.result
  }
}

// CASE create_then_await_handle expect=fire
func s5(_ items: [Int]) async {
  for item in items {
    let task = Task(priority: .high) {
      await work(item)
    }
    await task.value
  }
}

// CASE create_then_await_handle_plain expect=fire
func s5b(_ items: [Int]) async {
  for item in items {
    let task = Task {
      await work(item)
    }
    _ = await task.value
  }
}

// CASE awaited_argument expect=fire
func s6(_ items: [Int]) async {
  var tasks: [Task<Void, Never>] = []
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(
      Task(priority: await pick(item)) {
        await work(item)
      })
  }
}

// CASE paren_await_value expect=fire
func s7(_ items: [Int]) async -> [Int] {
  var out: [Int] = []
  for item in items {
    let value = await (Task(priority: .utility) { await work(item) }).value
    out.append(value)
  }
  return out
}

// CASE sibling_await_after_task expect=fire
func s8(_ items: [Int]) async {
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(Task(priority: .utility) { await work(item) })
    await log(item)
  }
}

// CASE operation_label_value expect=fire
func s9(_ items: [Int]) async -> [Int] {
  var out: [Int] = []
  for item in items {
    out.append(await Task(priority: .utility, operation: { await work(item) }).value)
  }
  return out
}
